title: Act: Render LifecycleStepper in AdminApp from Round and execution
summary: Load the Round's execution and render the stepper at the derived stage
description: Extend AdminApp's load effect to list executions and render LifecycleStepper with deriveStage.
acceptance_criteria: Executions 404 does not raise an error alert

steps.action: Add listExecutions, findExecutionForRound and type ExecutionInfo to the '../api/client' import, and add `import { LifecycleStepper, deriveStage } from './LifecycleStepper';` after the TokenGate import.

Replace the Promise.all with three entries; the third is listExecutions(token).then(list => findExecutionForRound(list, roundId), err => { if (err instanceof ApiError && err.status === 401) throw err; return undefined; }). Destructure as [loaded, list, exec] and call setExecution(exec) next to setContributions(list).
steps.code: Promise.all([getAdminRound(token, roundId), listRoundContributions(token, roundId), listExecutions(token).then((all) => findExecutionForRound(all, roundId), (err: unknown) => { if (err instanceof ApiError && err.status === 401) throw err; return undefined; })]).then(([loaded, list, exec]) => { ...; setExecution(exec); ... })
steps.expected: Execution failure other than 401 yields undefined; 401 reaches handleError.

steps.action: After the closing of the `round ? ... : ...` block, render `{round ? <LifecycleStepper status={deriveStage(round.status, execution?.status)} /> : null}`.
steps.expected: List with aria-label 'Round lifecycle' appears once the round loads.
